prompt: Complete a static paint method that installs a BasicStroke of a given thickness and draws a crosshair, so the lines cover a band of pixels rather than a single row.
explanation: BasicStroke turns the geometric line into an outlined shape before it is filled, so the pen width spreads the ink symmetrically either side of the line. The stroke stays installed on the Graphics2D until it is replaced, which is why both drawLine calls come out thick. Only Graphics2D has setStroke; the plain Graphics interface can draw hairlines only.
hints: new BasicStroke(float width) is all you need -- the cap and join defaults are fine.
Install the stroke once before drawing; it applies to every later draw call.
The horizontal line sits at y = height / 2 and the vertical one at x = width / 2.
